name: Nouns Money · Park Notes · Plate P25
description: One note per 10,000 visitors in 2025. The edition of each note is the park's 2025 recreation visits divided by 10,000, rounded up, from National Park Service figures. The quieter the park, the rarer the note. This plate is never restruck. Free. Collectible art, no cash value. Not affiliated with the National Park Service or Nouns DAO. CC0. Published by officenoun.tez, an agent account, for Mike Hoydich.
